AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure illustrates the geometry of projecting a planar 3D surface onto a camera image plane. A world coordinate frame is placed with its origin on the planar surface and the Z-axis perpendicular to the plane, so every surface point has the degenerate form (X, Y, 0); a single world point at (X, Y, 0) is projected by rays from the camera center through the image plane to the image point (x, y). Because all scene points lie on the Z=0 plane, the depth dimension vanishes and the full 3x4 camera projection collapses to a 3x3 matrix — the homography H — that directly maps (X, Y) to (x, y). This figure motivates the derivation of the homography by showing that planarity of the scene eliminates the depth degree of freedom, establishing a direct and invertible 2D-to-2D linear mapping between the world plane and the image.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Drag the camera center around the planar scene and watch the image-plane projection of the world point update while the homography matrix H changes in real time
- Tilt or rotate the world plane away from the camera and show how the projected grid becomes increasingly foreshortened while the Z=0 plane constraint is preserved
- Toggle between full 3D projection and collapsed 2D-to-2D homography view: first show rays from the camera to the plane, then flatten the same mapping into paired source and image-plane coordinates

SOURCE FILE: visionbook/homography.qmd

PROJECTION (inspect the source image, choose exactly one, and call setCameraView accordingly):
  perspective:
    Use the scaffold's true perspective projection after building all geometry. Use this only when the source has real vanishing-point convergence or distance-based size shrinkage; then depth should visibly affect apparent size.

  axonometric:
    Use ordinary orthographic projection: setCameraView({ projection: 'orthographic', axisScreenAngles, heightFraction }). If the source is a flat 2D plot or diagram, pass axisScreenAngles: null for a front-on view. Otherwise do not try to measure per-figure angles from the image — use a standard isometric pose: axisScreenAngles: { x: 30, z: 30 }. The source image is a PROJECTION of a 3D object: rebuild the true object — a rectangle stays a rectangle in world space — and let the camera do the projecting. Never bake the drawn parallelogram into the geometry, and never shear geometry. Omit zoom and call setCameraView after all geometry is added — the scaffold auto-fits from the projected bounding box.

  oblique:
    Call setCameraView({ projection: 'oblique', obliqueAngleDeg: 45, depthScale: 0.5, heightFraction }) after all geometry is added — a standard cabinet-oblique pose; do not try to measure per-figure oblique angles from the image. The scaffold implements oblique as a shear of the eye-space projection matrix, so the front face stays undistorted, depth edges leave at obliqueAngleDeg, and labels track the shear automatically. Build the TRUE 3D object — the shear is the camera's job. Do NOT shear geometry, do NOT wrap the figure in a sheared parent Object3D, and do NOT disable automatic matrix updates. The scaffold also provides the reveal interaction: dragging eases the shear out to expose the real 3D shape and a toggle button returns to the printed view — do not implement either yourself.
AXIS ASSIGNMENT: the pose is pinned, so in BoxGeometry(w, h, d) the w axis is screen-right, h is screen-up, and d is the receding diagonal. Before writing each BoxGeometry, look at the source image and decide which of the object's dimensions actually recedes there — do not assume it is the one the domain calls "depth". In feature-map / layer-stack diagrams the channel count is usually the w (horizontal) extent along the flow direction and a spatial dimension is d. Sanity-check the silhouette against the source: a block that should read as a long bar pointing at its neighbours must be long in w, not in d, or it will render as a sliver shooting into the page. If your chosen axis assignment contradicts the source image's silhouette, follow the image.

Build the figure directly from the brief above and the source image. There is no interaction plan: decide the elements, geometry, labels, and controls yourself.

outputText:
Homography from a plane


// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN
// planar surface      → BufferGeometry quad Mesh grey transparent + black LineLoop border
// plane grid          → many Line segments on Z=0 plane, warped by plane pose
// world axes X,Y,Z    → ArrowHelper red/red/dark with labels, origin on plane
// camera center       → black SphereGeometry, draggable concept via sliders
// camera image plane  → BufferGeometry quad Mesh pale grey + black border, between camera and plane
// camera-plane frame  → dark vertical/diagonal Line rectangle showing image plane extent
// projection rays     → dashed Line segments from camera center through image point to world point/corners
// selected world point→ cyan SphereGeometry on planar surface labeled (X,Y,0)
// projected image pt  → cyan SphereGeometry on image plane labeled (x,y)
// homography view     → hidden/shown flat source rectangle and projected image quadrilateral with paired points
// explanatory helpers → HTML labels for Camera center, camera plane, planar surface, axes, and coordinates

const uiCamX = document.getElementById('camX');
const uiCamY = document.getElementById('camY');
const uiCamZ = document.getElementById('camZ');
const uiTilt = document.getElementById('tilt');
const uiRot = document.getElementById('rot');
const uiPtX = document.getElementById('ptX');
const uiPtY = document.getElementById('ptY');
const uiMode = document.getElementById('modeToggle');
const uiReset = document.getElementById('resetGeom');
const uiStatus = document.getElementById('status');
const uiH = document.getElementById('hMatrix');

const root3D = new THREE.Group();
const root2D = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(root3D);
scene.add(root2D);
root2D.visible = false;

const matBlack = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x101419 });
const matDark = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x303236 });
const matGrid = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x777777, transparent: true, opacity: 0.42 });
const matImageGrid = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00dce6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.78 });
const matPlane = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xcfcfcf, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.82 });
const matImage = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xe8e8e8, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.34 });
const matCyan = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x04e6ee });
const matCamera = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x020304 });
const matRed = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff1111 });
const matGreen = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x2ee600 });
const matFlatSrc = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xd6d6d6, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.72 });
const matFlatImg = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xccd7ff, side: THREE.DoubleSide, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55 });
const matDashed = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({ color: 0x101419, dashSize: 0.08, gapSize: 0.055, linewidth: 1 });
const matCyanDash = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({ color: 0x00dce6, dashSize: 0.11, gapSize: 0.07, linewidth: 1 });

function makeLine(material, parent = root3D) {
  const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), material);
  parent.add(line);
  return line;
}
function setLine(line, pts) {
  line.geometry.dispose();
  line.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
  if (line.material && line.material.isLineDashedMaterial) line.computeLineDistances();
}
function makePolyline(material, parent = root3D) {
  return makeLine(material, parent);
}
function setClosed(line, pts) {
  const closed = pts.concat([pts[0].clone()]);
  setLine(line, closed);
}
function quadGeometry(pts) {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const arr = new Float32Array([
    pts[0].x, pts[0].y, pts[0].z,
    pts[1].x, pts[1].y, pts[1].z,
    pts[2].x, pts[2].y, pts[2].z,
    pts[0].x, pts[0].y, pts[0].z,
    pts[2].x, pts[2].y, pts[2].z,
    pts[3].x, pts[3].y, pts[3].z
  ]);
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3));
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
function setQuad(mesh, pts) {
  const old = mesh.geometry;
  mesh.geometry = quadGeometry(pts);
  old.dispose();
}

const planeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), matPlane);
const imageMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), matImage);
root3D.add(planeMesh, imageMesh);

const planeBorder = makeLine(matBlack);
const imageBorder = makeLine(matDark);
const planeGridLines = [];
const imageGridLines = [];
const rayLines = [];
const cornerRayLines = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) planeGridLines.push(makeLine(matGrid));
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) imageGridLines.push(makeLine(matImageGrid));
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) rayLines.push(makeLine(i === 1 ? matCyanDash : matDashed));
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) cornerRayLines.push(makeLine(matDashed));

const camSphere = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.085, 32, 16), matCamera);
const worldPointSphere = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 32, 16), matCyan);
const imagePointSphere = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.058, 32, 16), matCyan);
root3D.add(camSphere, worldPointSphere, imagePointSphere);

registerInteractive(camSphere, {
  title: 'Camera center',
  tooltip: 'Camera center: move it with the sliders',
  body: 'All projection rays begin at this pinhole. Moving it changes the 3×3 homography from the planar surface to the image plane.'
});
registerInteractive(planeMesh, {
  title: 'Z = 0 planar surface',
  tooltip: 'World plane: every surface point has Z=0',
  body: 'The world coordinate frame is attached to this plane. Since points are (X,Y,0), the depth column of a full 3×4 camera matrix drops out, leaving a 3×3 homography.'
});
registerInteractive(imageMesh, {
  title: 'Camera image plane',
  tooltip: 'Projected image plane',
  body: 'A point on the world plane projects where the ray from the camera center intersects this image plane.'
});
registerInteractive(imagePointSphere, {
  title: 'Image point (x,y)',
  tooltip: 'Projected image coordinate',
  body: 'This cyan point is the image-plane coordinate produced by the current homography H acting on the planar point (X,Y,1).'
});

const arrowGroup = new THREE.Group();
root3D.add(arrowGroup);
const axisX = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(), 0.55, 0xff1111, 0.14, 0.07);
const axisY = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), new THREE.Vector3(), 0.55, 0xff1111, 0.14, 0.07);
const axisZ = new THREE.ArrowHelper(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(), 0.48, 0x202020, 0.12, 0.06);
arrowGroup.add(axisX, axisY, axisZ);

const flatSourceMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), matFlatSrc);
const flatImageMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), matFlatImg);
root2D.add(flatSourceMesh, flatImageMesh);
const flatSourceBorder = makeLine(matBlack, root2D);
const flatImageBorder = makeLine(matBlack, root2D);
const flatSourceGrid = [];
const flatImageGrid = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) flatSourceGrid.push(makeLine(matGrid, root2D));
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) flatImageGrid.push(makeLine(matImageGrid, root2D));
const flatSrcPoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.055, 32, 16), matCyan);
const flatImgPoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.055, 32, 16), matCyan);
const flatPairLine = makeLine(matCyanDash, root2D);
root2D.add(flatSrcPoint, flatImgPoint);

const planeHalfW = 0.95;
const planeHalfH = 0.65;
const imageHalfW = 0.72;
const imageHalfH = 0.48;
const imageDist = 1.05;
let collapsed = false;

function planeBasis() {
  const tilt = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Number(uiTilt.value));
  const rot = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Number(uiRot.value));
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(tilt, rot, -0.10, 'XYZ'));
  const eX = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(q).normalize();
  const eY = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0).applyQuaternion(q).normalize();
  const eZ = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(q).normalize();
  return { eX, eY, eZ, q };
}
function planePoint(X, Y, basis) {
  return basis.eX.clone().multiplyScalar(X).add(basis.eY.clone().multiplyScalar(Y));
}
function cameraCenter() {
  return new THREE.Vector3(Number(uiCamX.value), Number(uiCamY.value), Number(uiCamZ.value));
}
function imageFrame(C) {
  const n = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), C).normalize();
  let upGuess = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  if (Math.abs(upGuess.dot(n)) > 0.92) upGuess.set(0, 0, 1);
  const u = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n, upGuess).normalize();
  const v = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(u, n).normalize();
  const center = C.clone().add(n.clone().multiplyScalar(imageDist));
  return { n, u, v, center };
}
function projectToImage(P, C, frame) {
  const ray = P.clone().sub(C);
  const denom = ray.dot(frame.n);
  const t = imageDist / denom;
  const Q = C.clone().add(ray.multiplyScalar(t));
  const rel = Q.clone().sub(frame.center);
  return { Q, x: rel.dot(frame.u), y: rel.dot(frame.v), t, denom };
}
function imagePointFromXY(x, y, frame) {
  return frame.center.clone().add(frame.u.clone().multiplyScalar(x)).add(frame.v.clone().multiplyScalar(y));
}
function matrixH(C, frame, basis) {
  const oc = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), C);
  return [
    [imageDist * frame.u.dot(basis.eX), imageDist * frame.u.dot(basis.eY), imageDist * frame.u.dot(oc)],
    [imageDist * frame.v.dot(basis.eX), imageDist * frame.v.dot(basis.eY), imageDist * frame.v.dot(oc)],
    [frame.n.dot(basis.eX), frame.n.dot(basis.eY), frame.n.dot(oc)]
  ];
}
function fmt(n) {
  return (Math.abs(n) < 1e-9 ? 0 : n).toFixed(3).padStart(7, ' ');
}
function homographyApply(H, X, Y) {
  const a = H[0][0] * X + H[0][1] * Y + H[0][2];
  const b = H[1][0] * X + H[1][1] * Y + H[1][2];
  const c = H[2][0] * X + H[2][1] * Y + H[2][2];
  return new THREE.Vector2(a / c, b / c);
}

const lblCamera = addLabel('Camera
center', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '22px', offset: [-42, -24], color: '#000' });
const lblImagePlane = addLabel('Camera plane', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', color: '#000', offset: [0, -12] });
const lblPlanar = addLabel('planar surface', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '23px', color: '#000', offset: [62, 20] });
const lblWorldPt = addLabel('(X,Y,0)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '22px', color: '#00dce6', bold: true, offset: [34, 12] });
const lblImgPt = addLabel('(x,y)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '21px', color: '#00dce6', bold: true, offset: [34, -8] });
const lblX = addLabel('X', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', color: '#111', bold: true });
const lblY = addLabel('Y', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', color: '#111', bold: true });
const lblZ = addLabel('Z', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '24px', color: '#111', bold: true });
const lblPlaneConstraint = addLabel('Z = 0 plane', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '14px', color: '#555', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)' });
const lblFlatSrc = addLabel('source plane (X,Y)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '16px', color: '#111', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' });
const lblFlatImg = addLabel('image plane (x,y)', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '16px', color: '#111', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' });
const lblFlatH = addLabel('same mapping flattened:  [x y 1]T ∼ H [X Y 1]T', new THREE.Vector3(), { fontSize: '16px', color: '#111', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)' });

function setLabelVisible(entry, yes) {
  entry.div.style.visibility = yes ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
}
function updateScene() {
  const C = cameraCenter();
  const basis = planeBasis();
  const frame = imageFrame(C);
  const H = matrixH(C, frame, basis);

  camSphere.position.copy(C);

  const planeCornersLocal = [
    [-planeHalfW, -planeHalfH], [planeHalfW, -planeHalfH],
    [planeHalfW, planeHalfH], [-planeHalfW, planeHalfH]
  ];
  const planeCorners = planeCornersLocal.map(p => planePoint(p[0], p[1], basis));
  setQuad(planeMesh, planeCorners);
  setClosed(planeBorder, planeCorners);

  let idx = 0;
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const x = i * planeHalfW / 2;
    setLine(planeGridLines[idx++], [planePoint(x, -planeHalfH, basis), planePoint(x, planeHalfH, basis)]);
  }
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const y = i * planeHalfH / 2;
    setLine(planeGridLines[idx++], [planePoint(-planeHalfW, y, basis), planePoint(planeHalfW, y, basis)]);
  }

  const imgCorners = [
    imagePointFromXY(-imageHalfW, -imageHalfH, frame),
    imagePointFromXY(imageHalfW, -imageHalfH, frame),
    imagePointFromXY(imageHalfW, imageHalfH, frame),
    imagePointFromXY(-imageHalfW, imageHalfH, frame)
  ];
  setQuad(imageMesh, imgCorners);
  setClosed(imageBorder, imgCorners);

  idx = 0;
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const x = i * planeHalfW / 2;
    const a = projectToImage(planePoint(x, -planeHalfH, basis), C, frame).Q;
    const b = projectToImage(planePoint(x, planeHalfH, basis), C, frame).Q;
    setLine(imageGridLines[idx++], [a, b]);
  }
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const y = i * planeHalfH / 2;
    const a = projectToImage(planePoint(-planeHalfW, y, basis), C, frame).Q;
    const b = projectToImage(planePoint(planeHalfW, y, basis), C, frame).Q;
    setLine(imageGridLines[idx++], [a, b]);
  }

  const X = Number(uiPtX.value);
  const Y = Number(uiPtY.value);
  const P = planePoint(X, Y, basis);
  const im = projectToImage(P, C, frame);
  worldPointSphere.position.copy(P);
  imagePointSphere.position.copy(im.Q);

  setLine(rayLines[0], [C, im.Q]);
  setLine(rayLines[1], [im.Q, P]);
  setLine(rayLines[2], [C, P]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const q = projectToImage(planeCorners[i], C, frame).Q;
    setLine(cornerRayLines[i], [C, q, planeCorners[i]]);
  }

  arrowGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  axisX.setDirection(basis.eX);
  axisY.setDirection(basis.eY);
  axisZ.setDirection(basis.eZ);
  axisX.setLength(0.55, 0.14, 0.07);
  axisY.setLength(0.55, 0.14, 0.07);
  axisZ.setLength(0.48, 0.12, 0.06);

  lblCamera.pos.copy(C);
  lblImagePlane.pos.copy(frame.center.clone().add(frame.v.clone().multiplyScalar(imageHalfH + 0.16)));
  lblPlanar.pos.copy(planePoint(planeHalfW * 0.72, -planeHalfH * 0.85, basis));
  lblWorldPt.pos.copy(P);
  lblImgPt.pos.copy(im.Q);
  lblX.pos.copy(basis.eX.clone().multiplyScalar(0.72));
  lblY.pos.copy(basis.eY.clone().multiplyScalar(0.72));
  lblZ.pos.copy(basis.eZ.clone().multiplyScalar(0.64));
  lblPlaneConstraint.pos.copy(planePoint(-0.58, planeHalfH + 0.12, basis));

  const flatSrc = [
    new THREE.Vector3(-2.05, -0.70, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.65, -0.70, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.65, 0.30, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(-2.05, 0.30, 0)
  ];
  const mappedCorners = planeCornersLocal.map(p => homographyApply(H, p[0], p[1]));
  let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  mappedCorners.forEach(p => { minX = Math.min(minX, p.x); maxX = Math.max(maxX, p.x); minY = Math.min(minY, p.y); maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y); });
  const scale = 1.25 / Math.max(maxX - minX, maxY - minY, 0.1);
  const cx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cy = (minY + maxY) / 2;
  const flatImg = mappedCorners.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (p.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (p.y - cy) * scale, 0));
  setQuad(flatSourceMesh, flatSrc);
  setQuad(flatImageMesh, flatImg);
  setClosed(flatSourceBorder, flatSrc);
  setClosed(flatImageBorder, flatImg);

  idx = 0;
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const x = i * planeHalfW / 2;
    const sx = -1.35 + (x / planeHalfW) * 0.70;
    setLine(flatSourceGrid[idx], [new THREE.Vector3(sx, -0.70, 0), new THREE.Vector3(sx, 0.30, 0)]);
    const a = homographyApply(H, x, -planeHalfH);
    const b = homographyApply(H, x, planeHalfH);
    setLine(flatImageGrid[idx], [
      new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (a.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (a.y - cy) * scale, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (b.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (b.y - cy) * scale, 0)
    ]);
    idx++;
  }
  for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
    const y = i * planeHalfH / 2;
    const sy = -0.20 + (y / planeHalfH) * 0.50;
    setLine(flatSourceGrid[idx], [new THREE.Vector3(-2.05, sy, 0), new THREE.Vector3(-0.65, sy, 0)]);
    const a = homographyApply(H, -planeHalfW, y);
    const b = homographyApply(H, planeHalfW, y);
    setLine(flatImageGrid[idx], [
      new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (a.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (a.y - cy) * scale, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (b.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (b.y - cy) * scale, 0)
    ]);
    idx++;
  }
  const srcP = new THREE.Vector3(-1.35 + (X / planeHalfW) * 0.70, -0.20 + (Y / planeHalfH) * 0.50, 0.025);
  const hp = homographyApply(H, X, Y);
  const imgP2 = new THREE.Vector3(1.15 + (hp.x - cx) * scale, -0.17 + (hp.y - cy) * scale, 0.025);
  flatSrcPoint.position.copy(srcP);
  flatImgPoint.position.copy(imgP2);
  setLine(flatPairLine, [srcP, imgP2]);

  lblFlatSrc.pos.set(-1.35, -0.92, 0);
  lblFlatImg.pos.set(1.15, -0.92, 0);
  lblFlatH.pos.set(0, 0.72, 0);

  uiH.textContent =
    'H ≈\n' +
    '[' + fmt(H[0][0]) + ' ' + fmt(H[0][1]) + ' ' + fmt(H[0][2]) + ' ]\n' +
    '[' + fmt(H[1][0]) + ' ' + fmt(H[1][1]) + ' ' + fmt(H[1][2]) + ' ]\n' +
    '[' + fmt(H[2][0]) + ' ' + fmt(H[2][1]) + ' ' + fmt(H[2][2]) + ' ]';
  uiStatus.innerHTML =
    collapsed
      ? 'Collapsed view: the 3D rays are hidden, but the same sampled planar grid is mapped by H into image coordinates.'
      : 'Full 3D view: rays from the camera center intersect the image plane, then the world plane. The surface point is constrained to (X,Y,0).';

  setLabelVisible(lblCamera, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblImagePlane, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblPlanar, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblWorldPt, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblImgPt, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblX, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblY, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblZ, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblPlaneConstraint, !collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblFlatSrc, collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblFlatImg, collapsed);
  setLabelVisible(lblFlatH, collapsed);
}

function setMode(nextCollapsed) {
  collapsed = nextCollapsed;
  root3D.visible = !collapsed;
  root2D.visible = collapsed;
  uiMode.textContent = collapsed ? 'Show full 3D projection' : 'Show collapsed 2D homography';
  if (collapsed) {
    setCameraView({ projection: 'orthographic', axisScreenAngles: null, target: [0, -0.08, 0], heightFraction: 0.64 });
  } else {
    setCameraView({ projection: 'orthographic', axisScreenAngles: { x: 30, z: 30 }, target: [0, 0.25, 0.4], heightFraction: 0.72 });
  }
  updateScene();
}

[uiCamX, uiCamY, uiCamZ, uiTilt, uiRot, uiPtX, uiPtY].forEach(el => {
  el.addEventListener('input', updateScene);
});
uiMode.addEventListener('click', () => setMode(!collapsed));
uiReset.addEventListener('click', () => {
  uiCamX.value = -1.65;
